# Standard

This folder documents the specific numerical standards and development goals established for clinical quality indicators within the Danish Acute Surgery Database. It details the exact percentage thresholds for process and outcome metrics, such as time-to-antibiotics, CT scan completion, surgical intervention windows, postoperative mobilization, and mortality rates. These benchmarks define the expected level of care and are used to evaluate hospital performance and guide quality improvement efforts across regions.

## Pages

- [[standard|Standard]] — Catalogs the precise percentage thresholds and development targets for all acute surgery clinical indicators, including time-sensitive interventions and mortality outcomes.
